content.title: Progressive stock sinks on Q3 miss, gold hits yet another record
content.description:
Yahoo Finance anchor Julie Hyman tracks Wednesday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute.

Gold (GC=F) notched yet another record high at $4,200.

Progressive (PGR) stock is sinking after the company reported third quarter earnings results that missed estimates.

Sana Biotechnology (SANA) stock is jumping after Opendoor (OPEN) investor Eric Jackson announced that he's long on the stock.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.
